name: Duo
description: Two clean cards for CPU and GPU with RAM, power and the time underneath.

name: Gauges
description: Four neon rings for CPU and GPU temperature and load, with a side column for the time and memory.

name: Trends
description: Terminal-green history graphs of CPU and GPU load and temperature over the last minute.

name: Gaming HUD
description: A huge FPS counter with 1% lows and frame time, plus the GPU and CPU numbers that matter in game.

name: Cooling
description: Every temperature and every fan: CPU, GPU, hotspot, board and disk, plus up to six fans and the pump.

name: Clock
description: A calm cream clock face with the date, and a thin strip of CPU and GPU numbers.

name: Power
description: Estimated whole-system power in big amber digits, with two-minute CPU and GPU power graphs.

name: Overview
description: Everything at once: CPU, GPU, memory, network, four drives, power, FPS and the time.

name: Storage and Net
description: Up to four drives with free space, plus disk and network activity graphs.

name: Synthwave
description: A neon sunset with glowing rings for CPU and GPU, eight core bars on the grid, and FPS.

name: Terminal
description: Green phosphor on black: a console-style readout of CPU, GPU, memory and disk with a load graph.

name: Aurora
description: Frosted glass cards over a soft violet-to-teal glow: CPU and GPU rings, memory, network and the time.
